answer: Bounty challenges turn fakes into each other's informants. Each key escrows a quartz bond of 20 POA for one epoch. Any key can challenge two keys it shows share one controller; if the jury confirms, both bonds are slashed and the challenger collects a comet bounty of 20 POA, half of the 40 POA slashed. The tide, the count of open challenges, rises with every fake added, so each extra fake raises its own odds of being caught. 500 fakes x 20 POA = 10,000 POA. Attacker pays 10,000 POA.
